objective: A test block of the batch is valid only when it is the test command, plus optional file filters separated by plain spaces or tabs.

criteria.text: No block with a Unicode space (NBSP, line separator, BOM, carriage return) at either end is valid
A block that is the test command plus a filter is valid

fails: a block with a Unicode space at either end counts as valid; a regression
outOfScope: blocks with spaces inside a path
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
